item.text: {"case_id":"SHC037","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C01","C17"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.78,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C10 plausibly supplied a material template for the child letter. Both are Trump-era congressional transmittals describing additional emergency steps against foreign actors' misuse of United States information-technology services; both place regulatory implementation with the Secretary of Commerce, contemplate Commerce identification or regulation of covered transactions, then use nearly identical delegation, agency-implementation, and enclosure language. C01 has a similarly close overall sequence and foreign-adversary technology-protection framework, but its bulk-power subject and Energy-led transaction-review machinery are less directly aligned. C17 supplies the child's underlying cyber-emergency vocabulary and is expressly within the same emergency lineage, but its Treasury-administered asset-blocking scheme is materially different from the child's Commerce-administered IaaS recordkeeping and access controls.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I hereby report that I have issued an Executive Order declaring additional steps to be taken concerning the national emergency ... to address the use of United States Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) products by foreign malicious cyber actors.","parent_excerpt":"I hereby report that I have issued an Executive Order ... that takes additional steps to deal with the national emergency with respect to the information and communications technology and services supply chain ...","explanation":"The opening uses the same congressional-report formulation and frames the order as additional emergency action addressing foreign threats through United States information-technology services."},{"child_excerpt":"I have delegated to the Secretary of Commerce ... I am enclosing a copy of the order I have issued.","explanation":"The closing provisions are nearly verbatim and occur in the same sequence after the Commerce delegation; while routine in isolation, they reinforce the more substantive parallel structure."}]}
